    Create Metro Nodes

    Source: R/createNodes.R
    nodeStatsMetro.Rd

    Create Metro Nodes

    Usage

    nodeStatsMetro(y)

    Arguments

    y

    Data Frame

    Value

    A data frame with one row per metropolitan area: airport (city market id), pass_dep (departing passengers), pass_arr (arriving passengers), pass_tr (transfer passengers, 0 when the data has no trip_break column), the metropolitan area information from MetroLookup (latitude, longitude and description) and freq (arrivals plus departures minus transfers).

    Examples

    OD_Metro <- OD_Sample
OD_Metro$origin <- OD_Metro$origin_mkt_id
OD_Metro$dest <- OD_Metro$dest_mkt_id

nodeStatsMetro(OD_Metro)
